codeReview.summary: The mobile week view was successfully ported to use NativeWind v5 Tailwind classes. It correctly implements the 7-day columns, time grid, overlapping positioned events, and current time indicator. Touch targets are appropriately sized using `min-h-11` and `hitSlop`. One minor omission is that all-day events are filtered out but not rendered in the header as they are in the web version.

issues.description: All-day and multi-day events are filtered out of the day grid but are not rendered anywhere in the week view, unlike the web version which renders them in the day header.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker executed `.factory/init.sh` directly. This script is not documented in AGENTS.md or services.yaml commands. Services.yaml lists `install` as `cd apps/mobile && bun install`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows execution of `sh "C:/Users/Roan/Documents/rocal/.factory/init.sh"` during verification.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used React Native's `hitSlop` property to achieve the 44pt touch target requirement on the 13px quarter-hour cells without altering the grid layout. This is an elegant pattern for mobile that isn't documented in the shared knowledge base but should be.

summary: Passed review. The component meets all requirements, using NativeWind classes correctly and matching the web layout's structure. Missing all-day event rendering noted as a non-blocking issue.
